title: Qt: RTP analysis fixups
description:
Make a base clase for RtpPlayerDialog and RtpStreamDialog, and define
some common slots there. Use that to simplify the RTP analysis code.
Conditionally compile more of the RTP analysis code.

commits_data.message:
Qt: RTP analysis fixups

Make a base clase for RtpPlayerDialog and RtpStreamDialog, and define
some common slots there. Use that to simplify the RTP analysis code.
Conditionally compile more of the RTP analysis code.
